title: Align dispatcher skill and repository policy with scoped IDs
description: Update skills/codex-wtp-loop/SKILL.md so the dispatcher resolves and runs in the intended Git worktree, understands that task next only returns current-branch or legacy work, does not treat foreign tasks as an empty-store bug, and carries opaque scoped TASK_ID values unchanged into worker prompts and follow-ups. Update CHANGELOG Unreleased and CONTRIBUTING task-history policy to describe merge-safe branch allocation and the remaining explicit-start/branch-rename behavior. Keep the loop's model mapping, full-access requirement, thread-only dispatch, atomic claim, monitoring, and terminal-state rules unchanged. Validate both skill files' frontmatter and imperative clarity.
